definitions.explanation: The plural form of これ, referring to multiple things near the speaker.

examples.japanese: これら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
これら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
これら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: These dishes were all made by my mother.

examples.japanese: これら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返|かえ}さ→返す：09648_kaesu⟧⟦なければなりません→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: These books were borrowed from the library, so I have to return them by next week.

notes:
これら is the plural form of ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ (this), meaning "these." It is more formal and explicit about plurality than ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ alone.

DEMONSTRATIVE PLURALS:
- これら: these (near speaker)
- ⟦それら→それら：22844_sorera⟧: those (near listener)
- ⟦あれら→あれら：23758_arera⟧: those (far from both)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- これら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: these ~
- これら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: these (as subject)
- これら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: these (as object)

REGISTER:
これら is more common in writing, presentations, and formal speech. In casual conversation, ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ is typically used even when referring to multiple items. Academic papers and news frequently use これら.

USAGE:
Japanese does not normally mark plurals explicitly. これら is used when the speaker wants to clearly indicate multiple items.
